about_the_game:
Dive deeper into the dark and mystical world of Night is Coming with this exclusive DLC.

This lore-rich digital artbook offers 30 pages of beautifully illustrated content, taking you behind the scenes of the game's creation.

Learn how the world, inspired by Slavic mythology and the haunting beauty of Eastern European nature, came to life. Uncover fascinating details about the development process, and explore stories and legends behind the monstrous creatures that roam the night. From concept art and character designs to detailed enemy descriptions and hidden facts from the game's lore — this artbook is a must-have for fans who want to immerse themselves further in the atmosphere of Night is Coming.

This package includes:

  • Digital Artbook (Lorebook) — 30 richly illustrated pages with detailed notes and descriptions

  • 10 wallpapers for your computer

  • 10 wallpapers for your smartphone

Support the developers and bring a piece of this dark fantasy world with you wherever you go.

Artbook is fully translated into the following languages:

  • English

  • German

  • Spanish

  • Polish

  • Russian

Once downloaded, you can access the Artbook and Wallpapers in your local files under: \steamapps\common\Night is Coming\Night is Coming - Artbook + Wallpapers
